allow: PowerShell(uv run python -c "import fastapi, pydantic, langgraph, chromadb, langchain_openai, httpx; print\('All imports OK'\)")

PowerShell($env:Path = "C:\\Users\\Administrator\\.local\\bin;$env:Path"; $job = Start-Job -ScriptBlock { param\($d\) cd $d; uv run uvicorn src.opensource_analyst.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 2>&1 } -ArgumentList \(Get-Location\).Path; Start-Sleep 6; try { $r1 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8001/" -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "GET / → $\($r1 | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\)" } catch { Write-Host "GET / FAILED: $_" }; try { $r2 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8001/health" -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "GET /health → $\($r2 | ConvertTo-Json -Compress\)" } catch { Write-Host "GET /health FAILED: $_" }; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:8001/docs" -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "GET /docs → Swagger OK" } catch { Write-Host "GET /docs FAILED: $_" }; Stop-Job $job -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Job $job -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
